name: yipei-monorepo
description: Public marketing site monorepo with retained app and studio workspaces.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @yipei/site" "npm run dev --workspace @yipei/web" "npm run dev --workspace @yipei/studio"
scripts.dev:site:legacy: npm run theme:legacy && npm run dev:site
scripts.dev:site:cinematic: npm run theme:cinematic && npm run dev:site
scripts.build:full: npm run build --workspace @yipei/site && npm run build --workspace @yipei/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @yipei/site && npm run build --workspace @yipei/web && npm run build --workspace @yipei/studio
scripts.build:site:legacy: npm run theme:legacy && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site:cinematic: npm run theme:cinematic && npm run build:site
scripts.check:web: npm run lint:web && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.check:all: npm run check:site && npm run check:web && npm run check:studio
